data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6117 recorded a gross prior-year reserve release of GBP 5.786m (a ~9.6% release on opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 60.337m). The managing agent attributes the improvement primarily to favourable claims experience on longer-tail items and Specialty classes affecting the 2021 and 2022 years of account. The release is modest in size and reflected in the change in estimates of prior year provisions in the technical provisions note.
raw_causal_phrases: The Syndicate has also seen improvement in its prior year reserves for 2021 & 2022, due to good experience on its longer tail and Specialty classes.
Change in estimates of prior year provisions (5,786)
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves and prior-year movement taken from Balance Sheet (claims outstanding comparative column) and Technical Provisions note 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' respectively. exact_reserve_text is a narrative sentence from the Chairman's statement; the numeric prior-year movement is taken from Note 9. LOB mapping for the reserve movement is inferred from the phrase 'Specialty classes' and is therefore given medium confidence. gross_premium_mix uses the single available class 'Reinsurance acceptances' because no detailed regulatory segmental breakdown by standard statutory class was provided for the full year in the notes.
